sections.text_helper: Section 20.3.6 "Stream switch" in chapter 20 (Neural-ART accelerator™ (NPU)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1015.
sections.section_content:
This switch dynamically connects output stream link ports to input stream link ports,
depending on the configuration data written to the configuration registers.
All input stream link ports can forward their data streams to one or multiple (multicast) output
ports at the same time, allowing replication of the data stream.
Two stream links can be connected to a single output port of the switch. In this case, the
output data are managed using a time-division context switch approach.
